name: HB Inc.
source:
In a desperate attempt to land a job you find your life in the hands of a Corrupt CEO. Though she makes it clear that she doesn’t care for you, you find yourself being of more use than a regular employee.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4942650/]Steam[/url]]
